match.title: Match calculator
match.intro: Enter the level of the candidate or employee per skill. The calculator computes the fit, shows the gaps and warns on knockouts. Nothing is stored and nothing is sent.
match.band.blocked: Not suitable: a knockout skill is below target level
match.disclaimer: This outcome supports a conversation, it is not a decision rule. Only enter levels based on a measurement or a structured assessment. Always combine with a structured interview.
